authorization: V77 proved that changing the shared installer/base host invalidates the sealed precision contract. One isolated v23 successor may implement the same bounded mechanism without modifying any sealed source byte or importing external acquisition code, artifact, data, output, or evidence.
objective: Construct-certify one isolated zero-parameter, v22-tensor-compatible successor that authenticates and parses a package exactly once per activation and reuses an already identical residual-route state while preserving every v22 output, security, lifecycle, package, persistent-state, and physical-execution behavior.

implementation_boundary.v23_package_requirement: A package must be explicitly signed for the v23 ABI and declare the single_authenticated_package_activation feature; v22 packages fail closed.
implementation_boundary.single_parse_installation: The isolated v23 installer receives only the CakePackage returned by its own authenticated inspect call, repeats host compatibility and dependency checks, stores the exact content-addressed archive, and writes the same registry fields before tensor binding.
implementation_boundary.route_reuse: Elide only an identical (route, batch) assignment already present on every active block; any route, batch, activation, replacement, or removal boundary invalidates the cache.

decision_rule: Implement only new isolated v23 source/evaluation/test files. Pass only if sealed shared source hashes remain byte-exact, the v23 construct passes every gate, focused and complete tests pass, and the unchanged campaign verifier still passes all eight sealed phases. Any shared-source, tensor, precision, output, security, lifecycle, or verifier change fails.
claim_boundary: Generic isolated v23 host construct only. No external artifact, ABI acquisition, English quality, information minimum, physical speed or memory, campaign-phase recertification, or ABI-superiority claim.
